feeds.title: Nevada Moms
feeds.description: Nevada Moms is your ultimate family-friendly resource to all things local - activities, food, events, businesses, and more! We're here to bring you the good, the bad, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Always Expect Moore
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carolina. A Well-intentioned Mom who enjoys doing all kinds of crafting, and teaching others how to create! Here on my site, you'll find lots of step-by-step craft and sewing tutorials, as well as recipes and my general musings.

feeds.title: {Not Quite} Susie Homemaker
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Shell. I'm a mom to two boys and I'm married to my high school sweetheart. I discovered a love of cooking and have really enjoyed bringing new recipes to this site. I also love to write about those that I love. I also share products that make life easier and everything that makes life fun- entertainment, style, beauty, crafts, travel, holiday inspiration, and DIY.

feeds.title: Jill Will Run
feeds.description: Jill Whitaker is a Certified Running Coach, positive body image advocate, telecommuting web geek, and a mom. The blog is used to chronicle her running experiences, share information about running & health, review products, and promote positive body image.

feeds.title: Jamie Y Blog
feeds.description: Jamie Y is a Las Vegas Wedding Photographer Specializing in Edgy Weddings, Portraits, Children, Engagement, and Boudoir.

feeds.title: Home Cooking Memories
feeds.description: I'm Brandie and this is my blog. I'm married to David and we live in Las Vegas, NV with our 4 children. Here, I share creative & easy recipes that are making memories in my home but also share modern-day recipe keeping techniques and ideas so you can preserve your food & recipe memories.

feeds.title: Gaby J Photography Blog
feeds.description: The Blog Of Las Vegas Wedding and Elopement Photographer Gaby J Photography featuring destination weddings from Las Vegas. Gaby Jeter is a wedding & food photographer, and is named one of the best wedding and elopement photographers in the US.

feeds.title: Ashley Diana
feeds.description: Ashley Diana is an Influencer, Speaker and Business Mentor committed to inspiring and educating women to live happy and successful lives. Through her Blog, she empowers and inspires women to become the best version of themselves.

feeds.title: Growing Up Gabel
feeds.description: My name is Camille Gabel and I am a wife, blogger, and mom to Ella and Miles. Growing Up Gabel is a family-fun lifestyle blog featuring delicious recipes, easy crafts, family travel, & real family life!

feeds.title: Kristen Marie Weddings + Portraits Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kristen, the owner, and photographer behind Kristen Marie Weddings + Portraits. Check out my blog to view my recent works. I photograph love of all kinds in Las Vegas and destinations everywhere. My style is timeless and relaxed, yet polished. I am absolutely passionate about preserving your memories through your images, and with my natural posing and editing style.

feeds.title: Scheme Planning & Design Blog
feeds.description: Las Vegas Wedding Planners & Designers specializing in boutique designer weddings. Tara is the author behind the blog and a mom herself.

feeds.title: Senior Style Bible
feeds.description: Senior Style Bible was created to celebrate the unmistakable allure of the mature woman and inspire a more modern approach to fashion. Our goal is to inspire women of a certain age to embrace an ageless attitude and adopt a more youthful outlook on life.

feeds.title: The Pinning Mama Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kimber. Mom of 3 and Chief Creativity Officer at The Pinning Mama. Here you will find: Easy, home-cooked family meals with side, freezer, and leftover suggestions, Simple Craft & Silhouette Tutorials, Stress-free Activities for Kids and more.
